> Backend, Desktop and AI-focused software developer. Based in Spain.

## Summary

Software developer with a strong academic background and hands-on experience
in backend systems, desktop applications, and artificial intelligence projects.
Currently completing a Higher Technician degree in Multiplatform Application
Development (DAM) with a GPA of 9.3/10.

## Experience

- **Role:** Software Developer Intern — Microvalencia Soluciones Informáticas S.L.
- **Period:** March – June 2026 (383 h)
- **Stack:** Flutter, Dart, PHP, Laravel, REST API, MVVM, SOLID, Dio, FlutterSecureStorage, Geolocator, Flutter Flavors
- **Scope:** Full-stack internship. Designed and developed a complete Flutter mobile
  app to extend the company ERP to smartphones. Implemented ~90% of the PHP/Laravel
  API layer from scratch (endpoints, role-based permissions, mobile-optimised responses).
  App covers nine modules: authentication with configurable server URL, remember-URL/user
  options and automatic session restore; clock-in/out with optional GPS; incident tracking;
  internal messaging with real-time polling and unread badge; work orders with audio
  recording, image attachments and digital client signature; visit reports linked to clients;
  client management with five document types and Maps integration; holiday management;
  and role-based access control across six user profiles. Feature-based clean architecture
  with MVVM and SOLID, immutable state per module, 3-layer error handling (15 error types),
  FlutterSecureStorage with Xiaomi/MIUI Keystore fallback, real-time server downtime
  detection with navigation lockout, dark/light theme toggle, and two production variants
  (full and lite) from the same codebase via Flutter Flavors.

## Featured Projects

- **Microvalencia ERP App** — Full-featured Flutter mobile app built during an internship at Microvalencia Soluciones Informáticas S.L.
  Stack: Flutter, Dart, PHP, Laravel, REST API, MVVM, SOLID, Dio, FlutterSecureStorage, Geolocator, Flutter Flavors.
  Acts as a mobile gateway to the company ERP. ~90% of the PHP/Laravel API layer was designed and implemented from scratch.
  Modules: authentication (configurable server URL, remember URL/user, auto session restore), clock-in/out with optional GPS,
  incident tracking, internal messaging with real-time polling, work orders with audio/image attachments and digital client signature,
  visit reports linked to clients, client management (5 document types, Maps), holiday management, role-based access control
  (superAdmin, admin, user, worker, client, supplier). Internationalisation in Spanish, Valencian, Catalan and English.
  Dark/light theme toggle. 3-layer error handling (15 types). FlutterSecureStorage with Xiaomi/MIUI fallback.
  Real-time server downtime detection. Two production variants (full/lite) via Flutter Flavors. Planned for Google Play Store and App Store.
  Demo: https://youtu.be/lrgRXaBEdI4

- **Cinema App** — Flutter movie discovery app consuming 9 REST endpoints of The Movie Database (TMDB) API.
  Stack: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, go_router, Dio, DTO/Entity Mapping, Drift (SQLite), Postman.
  Clean Architecture (domain/infrastructure/presentation) with a dedicated datasource and mapper layer (MovieMapper, ActorMapper, GenreMapper) converting TMDB API DTOs into domain entities, with endpoint responses inspected and verified in Postman before modeling the DTOs. Riverpod state management, go_router StatefulShellRoute navigation, and Drift/SQLite for local favorites persistence. Features an autoplay slideshow, four infinite-scroll movie lists, debounced search, genre-based browsing with per-genre pagination, and a favorites masonry grid. Includes a unit test suite (mappers, repositories, pagination notifier) with mocktail.
  Repository: https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/Cinema_App
  Demo: https://youtube.com/shorts/67coTqVxwA4?feature=share

- **CS50 AI** — Structured repository of 13 CS50 AI exercises across 7 course units.
  Stack: Python, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NLTK, Pygame.
  Covers graph search, Minimax, propositional inference, probabilistic reasoning, CSP optimization, k-NN, Q-learning, CNN image classification and NLP/attention exercises.
  Repository: https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/harvard_ai

- **DuckyWare** — Hardware e-commerce backend web application.
  Stack: Python, Django, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
  Includes database-driven categories, stock-aware carts, discount logic, order processing, user profiles, dynamic search and PayPal payment integration.
  Repository: https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/final_project_cs50w

- **OnlineStore** — Desktop store-management application with JavaFX and MVC architecture.
  Stack: Java, JavaFX, ORM, DAO, MVC.
  Includes customer, product, stock and order workflows, MySQL persistence through JDBC and Hibernate/JPA, DAO/Factory patterns, SQL scripts and JUnit tests.
  Repository: https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/UOC_ojoaldato
